spans.s: यदागम ( परिभाषा ) short familiar wording for the dictum or Paribhaasaa यदागमास्तद्गुणीभूतास्तद्ग्रहणेन गृह्यन्ते ' Par. Sek.

यदृच्छाशब्द् lit. a chance-word: Samjna-sabda or proper noun which is given accidentally without any found used attention to derivation or authority cf. अयं , तर्हि यदृच्छाशब्दोsपरिहार्यः। लृफिङ्: लृफिङ्ङ् M. Bh.on Siva Stra2.

यद्योग a connection with the word (pronoun) यत् by its use in the same sentence and context, which prevents the anudatta ( grave ) accent for the verb in the sentence; cf.निपातैर्यद्यदिहृन्तकुविन्नेच्चेच्चण्कच्चिद्यत्रयुक्तम्
; cf also the usual expression यद्योगादानघात: found in commentary works.
यद्वृत्त lit a word formed from यत्; a word which contains the pronoun यत् in it which prevents sarvaanudatta for a verb which follows; cf. यदस्मिन्वर्तते यद्वृत्तम् M.. Bh. on
, where Uvvata explains यद्वत्तasयदो वृत्तं यद्वृत्तं सर्वविभक्त्यन्तं सर्वप्रत्ययान्तं च गृह्यन्ते । V.'Pr.
